_metadata.comparison_note: Design-characteristic comparison only — NOT experimental performance. Tools use different chemistries (HG Lab uses Chen 2005 stem-loop RT-qPCR; miRprimer/miPrimer use linear RT primers). Compares in-silico design metrics only (Tm, GC%, structure delta-G, predicted specificity, design success rate, speed). Wet-lab PCR efficiency comparison requires self-generated calibration data (see calibration/calibration_data_requirement.md).
_metadata.verification_method: per_assay reviewed: 50/50 success, mean Fwd Tm 60.0 degC, mean score 91.8, mean time 2.19s
limitations: Different RT chemistries (stem-loop vs linear) make direct efficiency comparison invalid
miRprimer / miPrimer columns are N/A (binary not installed); comparison is HG Lab only
Panel of 50 curated open-access hsa- miRNAs — may not represent full biological diversity
Design time includes network overhead (localhost); actual server latency will differ
_metadata.validation_note: Competitor columns are null (different RT chemistry / binaries not installed); scientific correctness is established by the `validation` block: 783/783 checks vs Chen 2005 deterministic ground truth + Wang 2017 specificity concordance. Includes a BYTE-IDENTICAL exact match of the miR-16 stem-loop RT primer + universal reverse to a published table, plus cross-system RT-overhang/forward concordance with Czimmerer 2013 (miR-1, miR-181a) and Yang 2014 (miR-150) — independent labs using different universal stem-loop bodies.

validation.purpose: Independent scientific validation of the design engine against published-methodology ground truth AND real published primer tables: one byte-identical exact match (same universal system) plus cross-system RT-overhang & forward concordance from independent labs/chemistries.
validation.method: Deterministic ground truth from the Chen 2005 stem-loop method (RT primer = fixed universal body + revcomp of 3'-terminal 6 nt; universal reverse = fixed constant; forward specific region = 5' prefix of the miRNA), recomputed independently from the sequence the tool used. Plus thermodynamic-plausibility windows and let-7 specificity concordance with Wang 2017.
sources: [Chen05] Chen C et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2005;33(20):e179 — original stem-loop RT-qPCR; RT primer hybridizes 6-8 nt at 3' end of mature miRNA.

[Wang17] Wang Y et al. Mol Med Rep. 2017;17(3):3690-3696. DOI 10.3892/mmr.2017.8297 (PubMed PMID 29257343) — let-7 members share 16 identical 5' nt; single-nucleotide discrimination; amplification efficiency 0.93-1.14.
[Var07] Varkonyi-Gasic E et al. Plant Methods 2007;3:12 — protocol; 6-nt overhang optimal.
[MIQE09] Bustin SA et al. Clin Chem 2009;55(4):611-622. DOI 10.1373/clinchem.2008.112797 (PMID 19246619) — qPCR efficiency 90-110% acceptable.

THIRD source: Chen C et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2005;33(20):e179, DOI 10.1093/nar/gni178 (PMID 16314309), supplementary 'TaqMan miRNA assays' — RT primer GTCGTATCCAGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCACTGGATACGACCGCCAA, byte-identical; forward CGCGCTAGCAGCACGTAAAT.

Czimmerer Z, et al. PLoS ONE 2013;8(1):e55168. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0055168, Table 2 (hsa-mir-155): RT GTTGGCTCTGGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCACCAGAGCCAACACCCCT, forward GTGGGTTAATGCTAATCGTGAT. Also Yang L-h, et al. PLoS ONE 2014;9(12):e115293. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0115293: forward GCGGTTAATGCTAATCGTGATA (same miRNA-specific core; different USLP body). Forward-core comparison only. NOTE — overhang NOT scored: both papers anchor the RT primer on the older 23-nt mature miR-155 (3' end ...AGGGGU; Czimmerer overhang ACCCCT; Yang 8-nt ACCCCTAT), whereas miRBase v22 / this tool's database annotate hsa-miR-155-5p as 24 nt (3' end ...GGGGUU), giving overhang AACCCC. This is a reference-annotation difference, not a design error — but it means a primer ordered from the 2013/2014 papers binds a 1-nt-shifted 3' end.

Yang L-h, et al. Universal Stem-Loop Primer Method. PLoS ONE 2014;9(12):e115293. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0115293 — miR-150 forward qPCR primer (5' GC tail added to raise Tm). NOTE: Yang 2014 uses a different stem-loop body and reverse (random 3' end), so only the forward miRNA-specific core is comparable; no RT exact-match applies. Yang's miR-150 stem-loop 3' end is CACTGGTA (8 nt binding); this tool's 6-nt overhang CACTGG is its prefix — within Chen's 6-8 nt range, not scored.
